replies: Plenty: meat, fish, eggs, rice, pasta, potatoes and plain fruit and veg are all nut-free, so pasta with tomato sauce or roast chicken and potatoes works. Check the labels on chocolate, muesli, pesto and satay, and anything marked 'may contain nuts'.
You told me you're allergic to peanuts.
